metadata.summary: Six real changes from Hugging Face's trl, transformers, diffusers, peft and accelerate repositories, taken back out of the code. The subject makes each change again in the repository, and the change's own tests, run in a separate box, score it 0 or 1. Every task runs twice — once without a Skill, once with one. Six more tasks are kept apart: they are run once, on the winning Skill, and never decide the winner. Not a measure of broad capability.
metadata.title: HF Tasksmith
